title: The Hangover
about: Three friends wake up in a trashed Las Vegas suite with no memory of the night and no sign of the groom.
cue: Serve the drinks when the boys toast on the hotel roof.
faces: "I tend to think of myself as a one-man wolf pack."

The chicken wandering around the suite.
Alan still thinks Caesar lived here.
Scrambled eggs, crisp potato, chorizo and cheddar in flour tortillas, fresh salsa.
Lemon sponge layers filled with lemon curd and covered in buttercream.
Herbal liqueur and lime topped with ginger beer, served over ice with orange.
For the morning after, before you find Doug.
A tray charge applies to every order. Prices subject to change. Baby Carlos in the closet. Stu's missing tooth. Form RS 409. Images: TMDB.
